title: Rasch asks what jazz is
summary: Johnson challenges Rasch to say what jazz is before he will say whether his music belongs in it.

blocks.x: That's another thing I want to get with you.
It was a song, because if I write a song and don't take that sound (inaudible) but if I write a muse jazz. Now, you're going to write some jazz, all right, I'll write some jazz.
Now, what is jazz. That's what I'd like to ask you. You tell me what jazz is and I'll tell you whether it ought to be in that category. Am I making myself clear.
You're clear enough, it's just that what you got in me is a rather ignorant person when it comes down to it.
I don't try to classify you as a -- I classify you as not having been around a certain point and a certain time, that was all.
